title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 22
description:
Elevate your bedroom with this personalized baseball comforter set from Jeminise, designed for ultimate comfort and style. Perfect for baseball players, fans, and lovers, this set offers a soft and durable bedding solution that celebrates your passion for the game or makes a thoughtful custom gift.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your name for a unique touch, making it an ideal gift for men and women, moms and dads, or for special occasions.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to perfectly fit your bed.
  • Soft & Comfy Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling for a soft, comfortable, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges for lasting quality.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air-dried without heat, ensuring quick drying and fluffiness.
  • Sports Theme: Showcases a vibrant baseball thunder pattern, perfect for sports enthusiasts and adding a dynamic touch to any room.
  • Thoughtful Gift: An excellent gift for Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, or Christmas for anyone who loves baseball.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
